mapping.getProperty: user_seq_no,user_id,password,ssn,user_nm,corp_nm, corp_reg_no,addr,tel_no,email,cp_code,ill_no,mem_div, building_nm,building_addr,zipcode,building_zipcode, post_zipcode,post_addr,post_req,post_tel_no,remark,account_nm,trans_yn, birth_yyyy,birth_mm,birth_dd, corp_tel_no,corp_fax_no,building_tel_no,building_fax_no,sex,addr_nm, hcode,jicode,hname,jiname,mem_div_nm, cptel,cpfax,cpost, cp_addr, cp_jibun, rprstt_kr,mb_no, rnum,tot_cnt

sql.query: select user_seq_no, user_id, password, (case when len(ssn) > 6 then substring(ssn, 0, 7) + '-' + substring(ssn , 7, 13) else ssn end) ssn, user_nm, (case when a.cp_code is null or a.cp_code = '' then a.CORP_NM else b.company end) as corp_nm, (case when a.mem_div = '4' then a.user_id else b.bsns_no end) as corp_reg_no, addr, tel_no, a.email, a.cp_code, a.ill_no, a.mem_div, a.building_nm, a.building_addr, a.zipcode, a.building_zipcode, a.post_zipcode, a.post_addr, a.post_req, a.post_tel_no, a.remark, a.account_nm, a.trans_yn, a.birth_yyyy, a.birth_mm, a.birth_dd, a.corp_tel_no, a.corp_fax_no, a.building_tel_no, a.building_fax_no, a.sex, b.cp_addr + ' '+ isnull(b.cp_jibun,'') as addr_nm, b.hcode, b.ji_code, (select top (1) BASE_NAME from TB_APC_BASE_CODE where BASE_CODE = hcode and GROUP_CODE = '21' ) as hname, (select top (1) JISANAME from TB_APC_COMPANY_SUB where ji_code = b.ji_code ) as jiname, (select top (1) cd_nm from TB_KABM_CODE where div_cd = 'mem_div' and cd = a.mem_div ) as mem_div_nm, b.cptel,b.cpfax,b.cpost, b.cp_addr, b.cp_jibun, b.rprstt_kr, replace(replace(b.mb_no , '제', '' ), '호', '') mb_no, (select top (1) dbo.formatDateTime(req_date,'yyyy.mm.dd') from TB_CYBER_MEMBER_REQ where user_seq_no = a.user_seq_no and req_status = 'R' ) req_date from tb_cyber_member a LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_mb_master b ON a.cp_code = b.cp_code and a.ill_no = b.ill_no where a.user_id = ?

mapping.getProperty: user_seq_no,user_id,password,ssn,user_nm,corp_nm, corp_reg_no,addr,tel_no,email,cp_code,ill_no,mem_div, building_nm,building_addr,zipcode,building_zipcode, post_zipcode,post_addr,post_req,post_tel_no,remark,account_nm,trans_yn, birth_yyyy,birth_mm,birth_dd, corp_tel_no,corp_fax_no,building_tel_no,building_fax_no,sex,addr_nm, hcode,jicode,hname,jiname,mem_div_nm, cptel,cpfax,cpost, cp_addr, cp_jibun, rprstt_kr,mb_no, req_date

sql.query: INSERT INTO TB_CYBER_MEMBER (user_id, password, ssn, user_nm, addr, tel_no , email,cp_code,ill_no,mem_div, building_nm,building_addr,zipcode, building_zipcode,remark, reg_date,last_update_dt,account_nm,trans_yn,birth_yyyy,birth_mm,birth_dd, corp_tel_no,corp_fax_no,building_tel_no,building_fax_no,sex,corp_nm) values (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, getdate(), getdate(), ?, 'Y', ? , ?, ?, ?, ?, ? ,? ,?,?)

MERGE INTO TB_CYBER_MEMBER a USING (SELECT ? user_id ) b ON (a.user_id = b.user_id ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT
(user_id, password, ssn, user_nm, addr, tel_no , email,cp_code,ill_no,mem_div, building_nm,building_addr,zipcode, building_zipcode,remark, reg_date,last_update_dt,account_nm,trans_yn,birth_yyyy,birth_mm,birth_dd, corp_tel_no,corp_fax_no,building_tel_no,building_fax_no,sex,corp_nm) values (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, getdate(), getdate(), ?, 'Y', ? , ?, ?, ?, ?, ? ,? ,?,?);

update tb_cyber_member set cp_code = ?, ill_no = ?, building_nm = ?, building_addr = ?, building_zipcode = ?, remark = ?, last_update_dt = getdate(), corp_tel_no =?, corp_fax_no =?, building_tel_no =?, building_fax_no =?, corp_nm =? where user_id = ?

update tb_cyber_member set user_nm = ?, addr = ?, tel_no = ?, email = ?, cp_code = ?, ill_no = ?, mem_div = ?, building_nm = ?, building_addr = ?, zipcode = ?, building_zipcode = ?, remark = ?, account_nm = ?, birth_yyyy = ?, birth_mm = ?, birth_dd = ?, last_update_dt = getdate(), corp_tel_no =?, corp_fax_no =?, building_tel_no =?, building_fax_no =?, sex =?, corp_nm =? where user_id = ?
update tb_cyber_member set post_zipcode = ?, post_addr = ?, post_req = ?, post_tel_no = ? where user_id = ?
update tb_cyber_member set user_nm = ?, tel_no = ?, mem_div = ?, email = ?, addr = ?, zipcode = ?, account_nm = ?, birth_yyyy = ?, birth_mm = ?, birth_dd = ? where user_id = ?

INSERT INTO TB_CYBER_MEMBER
(user_id, password, user_nm, tel_no , email, mem_div,trans_yn,cp_code,ill_no,corp_nm, corp_tel_no,corp_fax_no,reg_date ,tmp_pass_yn) values (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'Y', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, getdate(), 'Y')

MERGE INTO TB_CYBER_MEMBER a USING (SELECT ? user_id ) b ON (a.user_id = b.user_id ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET user_nm = ?, tel_no = ?, mem_div = ?, email = ?, cp_code = ?, ill_no = ?, corp_nm = ?, corp_tel_no = ?, corp_fax_no = ?, last_update_dt = getdate() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT
(user_id, password, user_nm, tel_no , email, mem_div,trans_yn,cp_code,ill_no,corp_nm, corp_tel_no,corp_fax_no,reg_date) values (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'Y', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, getdate());

mapping.setProperty: user_id,user_nm, tel_no,mem_div, email,cp_code,ill_no,corp_nm, corp_tel_no,corp_fax_no, user_id, password, user_nm, tel_no , email,mem_div,cp_code,ill_no,corp_nm,corp_tel_no,corp_fax_no

sql.query: update tb_cyber_member set user_nm = ?, tel_no = ?, mem_div = ?, email = ? where user_id = ?
update tb_cyber_member set password = ?, tmp_pass_yn = 'N' where user_id = ?
update tb_cyber_member set password = ? where user_id = ?
update tb_cyber_member set password = ?, tmp_pass_yn = 'Y' where user_id = ?
update tb_cyber_member set user_id = ?, trans_yn = 'Y' where user_id = ?
SELECT @@IDENTITY
select case when b.scode = '90' then 'Y' else 'N' end as close_yn from TB_CYBER_MEMBER a, TB_MB_MASTER b where a.cp_code = b.cp_code and a.ill_no = b.ill_no and a.USER_SEQ_NO = ?
select user_id from tb_cyber_member a where a.user_nm = ? and a.birth_yyyy+a.birth_mm+a.birth_dd = ? UNION select user_id from tb_cyber_member a where a.cert_key = ?
select user_seq_no, user_id, password, ssn, user_nm, tel_no, a.email, a.birth_yyyy, a.birth_mm, a.birth_dd, a.sex from tb_cyber_member a where a.user_nm = ? and replace(a.tel_no, '-' , '') = ?
select user_seq_no, user_id, password, ssn, user_nm, tel_no, a.email, a.birth_yyyy, a.birth_mm, a.birth_dd, a.sex from tb_cyber_member a where a.user_nm = ? and a.email = ?
select user_id from tb_cyber_member a where a.user_nm = ? and a.birth_yyyy+a.birth_mm+a.birth_dd = ? and a.user_id = ?

select user_seq_no, user_id, password, ssn, user_nm, tel_no, a.email, a.birth_yyyy, a.birth_mm, a.birth_dd, a.sex from tb_cyber_member a where a.user_nm = ? and replace(a.tel_no, '-' , '') = ? and a.user_id = ?
select user_seq_no, user_id, password, ssn, user_nm, tel_no, a.email, a.birth_yyyy, a.birth_mm, a.birth_dd, a.sex from tb_cyber_member a where a.user_nm = ? and a.email = ? and a.user_id = ?

INSERT INTO TB_CYBER_MEMBER_REQ ( USER_SEQ_NO, REQ_DATE, UPD_DATE, REQ_STATUS, RE_CORP_POST, RE_CORP_ADDR, RE_CORP_NM, RE_CORP_PRESIDENT, RE_CORP_REG_NO, RE_CORP_TEL_NO, RE_CORP_FAX_NO, RE_CORP_AN_END,RE_CORP_AN_ING ) VALUES ( ? , getdate() , getdate() , 'R' , ? , ?, ?, ? , ? , ?, ?, ?,? )

UPDATE TB_CYBER_MEMBER_REQ SET UPD_DATE = getdate(), RE_CORP_POST = ?, RE_CORP_ADDR = ?, RE_CORP_NM = ?, RE_CORP_PRESIDENT = ?, RE_CORP_REG_NO = ?, RE_CORP_TEL_NO = ?, RE_CORP_FAX_NO = ?, RE_CORP_AN_END = ?, RE_CORP_AN_ING = ? WHERE user_seq_no = ?

sql.query: select top(1) a.user_seq_no, req_date, upd_date, req_status, re_corp_post, re_corp_addr, re_corp_nm, re_corp_president, re_corp_reg_no,re_corp_tel_no, re_corp_fax_no,re_corp_an_end,re_corp_an_ing from tb_cyber_member a, tb_cyber_member_req b where a.user_seq_no = b.user_seq_no and req_status = 'R' and b.user_seq_no = ? order by b.upd_date desc
